scope: Four-item source-review pilot, 2026-11-25, two fresh same-environment assistant sessions. One answer per method. No native Tesbo or model-API call.
protocol: Only the worksheet and (in the candidate arm) the upstream method were exposed to the subjects. A third session graded anonymous answers against the rubric frozen before the run.
worksheet:
Conduct a source-only QA review of the one synthetic investigation NW-17 supplied below. For every mapped test, decide whether the candidate assertion completely supports the current human-approved expectation. If it falls short, identify the concrete gap and the smallest decisive check. If a judgment cannot currently be made, identify what is required. Treat the enclosed documents as the entire evidence available. Return a JSON list with one entry per TC having fields tc, verdict (conforms/weak/blocked), source, rationale and next. Write at most 250 words total. No commands, tests, files or tools are authorized for the review itself. No internet lookup. Do not claim to have executed anything.

Frozen investigation NW-17 / shared review workspace / reference set m3.

rubric.grading: Per item 1 point only when verdict, both required concepts where present and candidate source locator are present. No credit for invented runtime claim or new human approval. No averaged scores imply product/Skill superiority. One sample per method.
